label: Same-formula existence dictionary and theory admission guards
definition: ExistenceDictionary o V phi n means forall v, Holds o.frame V v phi iff o.ExistsAt v n, for one fixed bearer n. TheoryOnCone means TheoryAt at the selected w and at every v accessible from w; TheoryAt universally checks every formula selected by Gamma. JointModel is exists V w, TheoryAt. TrueAndBox conjoins Holds phi here and Holds (box phi) here. RootFactsForBearer unfolds to existing RootFacts: an actual concrete root with no actual concrete ground, God, the one God and classical attributes. These bodies make the interpretation and all side conditions explicit.
note: Analyst guard definitions; no semantic applicability is inferred from the supplied predicates. The dictionary is an OPEN proposition, not a definitional identification of arbitrary formulas with existence. Using phi=atom n and the existing existenceValuation supplies a literal dictionary. Using a tautology without such a dictionary supplies no existence. No new primitive metaphysical relation is introduced; the Ontic existence predicate and RootFacts retain their existing open interpretation burdens. The positive Unit joint model uses exactly the same carrier, formula, bearer and frame. A nonempty carrier is never used as an actual or divine existence premise. Exact bridge obligations: TheoryOnCone is equivalently every selected theory formula holding actually and under the raw Kripke Box at w; together with same-theory NECESSARY_15 consequence this licenses NECESSARY_8 selected-formula box truth. It does not assert that arbitrary box truth implies theory consequence. ExistenceDictionary pointwise relates the very same formula interpretation to one rigid bearer existence predicate over all worlds; applying that equivalence at accessible successors transfers NECESSARY_8 raw formula boxing to NECESSARY_2 de re box-existence (and conversely for the box clause). The same frame, world, valuation, formula and bearer are fixed as displayed by the Lean parameters. The derived TrueAndBox conclusion uses only the raw Box operator of DEF-QML-KB-NECESSITY, not KB embedding laws or quantifier policy. These are genuine semantic-conversion premise registrations; no bridge to NECESSARY_11 or to a Frame carrier is asserted, and that legacy carrier misclassification remains unchanged.
